author: View Creative Agency
title: Senior Freelance Graphic Designer & Illustrator Wanted
content:
SENIOR FREELANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER & ILLUSTRATOR
We’re expanding our creative network at View Creative and looking for experienced freelancers to work with us on a project-by-project basis.
From branding and packaging to illustration and everyday design, you’ll bring strong ideas and the skills to make them happen.
You’ll need:
• 5+ years’ professional experience
• A strong creative and commercial portfolio
• Excellent Adobe Creative Suite skills
• Good working knowledge of Canva
Figma, animation and After Effects skills would be a bonus.
Creative, reliable and commercially minded? We’d love to hear from you.
Send your CV, portfolio and availability - DM us your details .
